audience: contractors and field service teams who run jobs, estimates and crew schedules in Projul

useCases.title: Review an estimate with its change orders
useCases.text: List the estimates of a project or client, then open one to see every version, its sections, line items and totals.

useCases.title: Check overdue invoices
useCases.text: List the invoices that are overdue, with their balance due and status. Open one invoice to see its line items and payments so far.

useCases.title: Plan the crew schedule for next week
useCases.text: List tasks and schedule items for a date window, with their assignments. Look up the people and teams to see who is booked.

useCases.title: Add a client and schedule a site visit
useCases.text: Create a client, or get the existing one when the names and an email or phone match. Then create a task with a time window and assignments.

useCases.title: Add a note to a project or task
useCases.text: List the notes on a record first. Then add a note to a project, task, client or estimate. The note is not sent to the client.

useCases.title: Check hours worked on a job
useCases.text: List time logs, filtered by person, project, task, date range, time type or approval.
